name: Udio
tagline: Udio is an AI music generation platform that produces high-fidelity, studio-quality songs from text prompts, with strong handling of lyrics, structure, and genre specificity. It allows users to extend, remix, and refine generated tracks with fine-grained control over individual sections. Musicians and content creators use Udio when audio quality and musical accuracy are the priority.
